summary: Intermittent data loss in merchant review stage
description: Merchant data entered by Sales Agents in the Sales UI is not transferring to the Processing stage even after completion, halting the onboarding process for affected merchants.
resolution: Reset the Sales Agent's access credentials for the onboarding portal associated with the affected merchant ID, allowing them to regain access and continue with the onboarding process without further interruptions.
